g.title: #97 POWER: connect medium pole | external electricity (19.5, -2.5)

g.text: West: four belt entrances (iron, steel, copper, plastic) · D = display panels · amber = provider chests (2 = AM2, 3 = AM3)
Always-on direct hand-offs: cable → circuit, cable → advanced circuit, advanced circuit → speed module, gear → AM1 and AM2, AM2 → chest → AM3.
Green circuit reads the whole ring; every feed arm and ring product arm is capped by it. All arms are fast inserters.
